title: Node streams and buffers
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: A service counts UTF-8 chunks using JavaScript string length and therefore underestimates multibyte payloads, allowing the maximum byte limit to be bypassed. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Use Node Readable and Buffer.byteLength for true UTF-8 byte budgets, collecting bounded chunks and cancelling oversized input.
Repair node-stream-buffer-limit and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for node streams and buffers.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.03 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
